Projekten im Unternehmenskontext.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
from itables import show

SHEET_ID = "1biR3sfazyxyKhLVVBfVgY5fjFxSF-3PjhzyquO9HbpQ"
GID = "1047384214"
url = f"https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{SHEET_ID}/export?format=csv&gid={GID}"

df = pd.read_csv(url)
show(
    df,
    classes="display compact stripe hover",
    style="width:100%; table-layout:auto; font-size:14px",
    paging=True,
    layout={
        "topStart": None,
        "topEnd": None,
        "bottomStart": "info",
        "bottomEnd": "paging",
    },
    columnDefs=[
        {"className": "dt-left", "targets": "_all"},
        {"width": "30%", "targets": "_all"},
    ],
)
```
